title: Rename StreakStateProvider — it is a plain service class, not a @riverpod provider

evidence.quote:
class StreakStateProvider {
  StreakStateProvider({required UserDatabase db, required LocalDayClock clock})

why: The file/class name (streak_state_provider.dart, StreakStateProvider) matches the app-wide convention for @riverpod codegen providers, but this is a hand-written plain class with no @riverpod annotation, no part '*.g.dart', and no Notifier/AsyncNotifier base — it's constructed directly by 5 different callers (parent_dashboard_aggregator.dart, streak_milestone_analytics_observer.dart, streak_alert_service.dart, streak_service.dart, dashboard_providers.dart). An auditor or agent grepping for '_provider.dart' files to apply the SM-1..8 rule family would misclassify this file and either skip real SM-7 questions (is it constructed only inside a real provider?) or misapply provider-specific rules that don't fit a plain service.
recommendation: Rename to streak_state_service.dart / StreakStateService (or similar) to match its actual role.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn 'class StreakStateProvider' lib/ returns zero hits after rename; all 5 call sites updated.
